summary: Bulk onboarding surge: temporary VPN bridge, seat reassignments, device ship windows, and short-term manager escalation
description:
Issue summary: HR has scheduled a hiring surge of 12 new CSM and Solutions hires starting 2026-03-16. They require staggered device shipments, ephemeral VPN access to customer staging VPCs for shadowing, and reassignment of existing Contractor seats for the ramp period. Also a temporary manager escalation privilege is requested for mentors for 30 days to approve early access exceptions.

Background/Impact: This is high-volume onboarding tied to a sales-driven ramp; delays in access or devices will push new hire ramp times and increase CS ramp costs. The request touches multiple teams (IT/devices, SRE/VPN, Security/KMS, Identity) and requires a documented short-term policy exception for manager escalation and seat swaps.

Requested deliverables: 1) A temporary VPN bridge pattern to provide scoped access to customer staging VPCs for 12 hires, with automatic expiration at 2026-04-16. 2) Process for reassigning 6 existing contractor RedSeat licenses to new hires and returning them in 45 days. 3) Device procurement and ship-window coordination (staggered: 4 devices per week across three weeks). 4) Temporary manager escalation policy for mentor accounts: 30-day, auditable, require manager + HR approval recorded. 5) KMS access exception (one hire needs read access to a test key in project-csm-staging) with explicit least-privilege grant and expiry.

Constraints and risks: - VPN bridge must not grant broad production access; only scoped staging subnets. - KMS exception must avoid exposing customer keys or production secrets. - Seat reassignments must be logged to avoid licensing conflicts. - Device shipments must comply with company asset tagging and MDM enrollment on receipt.

Proposed plan: 1) SRE to create ephemeral VPN bridge profiles (scoped, 7-day tokens) and provide an automated lifecycle that ties to HR start date. 2) Identity to create "onboarding-temporary" role allowing scoped VPC access and KMS-read on csm-test-key, auto-expire via IAM policy on 2026-04-16. 3) IT to prepare 12 devices with MDM images, 4 devices shipped each Monday starting 2026-03-16. 4) Security sign-off on manager-escalation flow documented in Confluence; require HR+people-lead approval recorded in request ticket.

Deliverable owner suggestions: SRE (Samir Patel), Identity (Ishaan Rao), IT devices (Ava Morales), Security (Nora Kim), HR coordinator (Priya Singh).
onboarding_checklist: Finalize list of 12 hires and start dates (HR provided spreadsheet)
Confirm which contractor seats are available for reuse and tag licenses
Create ephemeral VPN bridge profiles scoped to staging subnets
Create onboarding-temporary IAM role with KMS read for csm-test-key, expiry 2026-04-16
Prepare, image, and asset-tag 12 laptops; schedule 4/week ship windows
Record manager escalation approvals in ticket thread and Confluence form
Confirm MDM enrollment flows and conditional access policies
Verify audit logs for VPN bridge and KMS grants are routed to Splunk/observability
Close loop with Finance for temporary license adjustments and cost attribution
